briefTitle: Study of PF-07248144 in Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors

typedChecks.sourceText: Female or male patients aged ≥ 18 years (Japan ≥ 20 years) (South Korea ≥ 19 years).
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Female or male patients aged ≥ 18 years (Japan ≥ 20 years) (South Korea ≥ 19 years).

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Part 1A (Monotherapy Dose Escalation) Histological or cytological diagnosis of locally advanced or metastatic ER+HER2- breast cancer, CRPC, or NSCLC that is intolerant or resistant to standard therapy or for which no standard therapy is available.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: The trial enrolls multiple distinct cancer types with different rules per part, so no single stage or biomarker inclusion check applies broadly.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have at least 1 measurable lesion as defined by RECIST version 1.1 that has not been previously irradiated.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adequate renal, liver, and bone marrow function.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Adequate organ function is stated broadly without specific numeric cutoffs in this section.
